content: Insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh sent two health policy renewal quote options (Standard Renewal and Premium Plus) to customer Aditya Singh. Aditya reviewed the quotes, expressed interest in the Premium Plus option, and requested clarification on the annual deductible, the pre-authorization process for specialist visits, and the deadline to confirm renewal to prevent coverage gaps.

action_items: Clarify the annual deductible for the Premium Plus option
Explain the pre-authorization process for specialist visits
Confirm the deadline for confirming the policy renewal to avoid a coverage gap
